# Test fixtures

- `face-astronaut-public-domain.png` — NASA portrait of astronaut Eileen Collins (public domain, via scikit-image's sample data). Used only to exercise face detection and fake runs. It is **not** a child photo. Never commit real children's photos to this repo.
- `drawings/` — synthetic "photographed drawings" generated by `make_drawings.py` (perspective, table background, shadows) to test the clean-up step.
- `gender/example_books.json` — the words of the 7 published Magic example books (invented children, written by
  the text model; from `/api/examples`, 2026-10-07): real model output for the «تحقق من التذكير والتأنيث» check
  (`test_gender_check.py`), which must find nothing in them and must find the slips planted in copies of them.
